name: Yurgund
source:
Twin sister of Zirgund, and daughter of a wealthy merchant. She also serves as a maid servant to Tarakin.

She is a promiscuous beauty who uses her feminine wiles. She is "dating" Tarakin, but her true goal is to become queen in the future, and will use her body to achieve that goal.

Her sister, Zirgund serves Kiral.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/103kyonyu5/#character]official site[/url]]
